bounds: One real pending local OAuth flow observed over HTTP, one or two five-second comment heartbeats, then explicit cancellation. The pending and terminal data frames retain their meanings; comment frames do not complete OAuth. The conformance test uses the real flow registry and route and waits for transport closure.
limitations: No remote provider sign-in, proxy idle-timeout qualification, authorization middleware, network partition or concurrent subscriber claim. Progress assumes the timer is scheduled and the local cancellation is requested; the model declares weak fairness.

assumptions: Weak fairness of heartbeat and explicit cancellation; the local timer and HTTP transport remain available.
